name: Elqui Valley
shape: Chile Decreto 464, drawn from its comunas and provinces

climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: A northern Chilean valley in the Coquimbo region, at the southern end of the Atacama Desert, running from the Pacific to the Andes, up to 6,500 feet. It is known for table grapes and pisco, and is the north's most commercially successful wine region.
